scope: 216 native recovery source windows: CPU necessary-capacity followed by CPU source-topology witnesses only
source_order: preserve frozen candidate census exactly: patient ID, native ROI ID, y, x; ordered queue, all capacity receipts before topology subset
implementation_change: none; existing clean source-qualification entry points reused
timeout_scope: combined U1+U2 per source; timeout retained as unknown, not a biological failure
integrity_preflight: revalidate all648 input SHA, decoded content SHA, dimensions, labels, required tissue classes and27% Stroma before any capacity calls
stage_transition: all216 capacity controls reach terminal status; only sources with two valid positive capacity checks enter topology in unchanged source order
exception_policy: producer exception even inside exit0 is execution_error, never failed_condition or zero measurement
first_source_policy: first topology-pass source per patient is only a provisional source record; final qualification still requires all four targets and independent review
patient_union: set union of old17 topology-pass groups, old unknowns, new topology-pass groups and unresolved new groups; never add source counts as patient counts
source_distribution_note: all216 failed at least one historical training-export quality filter; retained as predeclared source candidates, not accepted cohort members
